last_agent_note: Use ASSET_PACK_SCHEMA.md and WORLD_SCHEMA.md as compatibility contracts. Keep AI/TTS/music/Live2D optional and preserve fallback mode. Packs outside game/ are inspect-only: never bind an absolute external path as a sprite. Asuna is Live2D Cubism 2 (.moc + .model.json + .mtn), not MMD, and Ren'Py 8.3.7 only loads Cubism 4 (.model3.json + .moc3), so those models are catalogued and never copied; the 225 PNG textures are the usable part. .pmx/.pmd/.vmd/.vpd are MMD and equally not displayable. unrpa 2.3.0 is vendored under game/vendor/unrpa/ (GPL-3.0) as a fallback reader for .rpi, RPA-3.2, RPA-4.0, zix and alt; the built-in reader stays first and unknown containers are refused. Third-party game assets live in game/absorbed/ with third_party=true and redistributable=false; normal world export copies their metadata only.
